info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trade Clearing API
info.description: The Trade Clearing API facilitates the processing and settlement of trades within the financial market. It enables users to submit trade clearing requests, ensuring timely and accurate reconciliation of transactions. This API is designed for financial institutions, trading platforms, and market participants looking to automate their trade clearing operations. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance operational efficiency and reduce settlement risks associated with trade activities.

post.summary: Clears a trade within the market operations.
post.description: This operation initiates the clearing process for a trade, ensuring that all necessary validations and settlements are completed efficiently and effectively. It handles the clearing logic for the trade input and updates the relevant market states.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a trade clearing operation within the market operations API. It contains all necessary information to process the trade and ensure compliance with the market rules.

202.description: Request has been accepted and is being processed.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while processing the request.

422.description: The request was well-formed but unable to be processed due to semantic errors.
